name: Last Call At Desert Blossom
source:
You're no stranger to living on the lam. You're The Fugitive, and this is your life.

Of course, being wanted in all the worst ways means you've got your fair share of bounty hunters hot in pursuit. Among them all, the most dogged seems to be one Walker T. Runner -- A strange MechHead assassin who takes great delight in your little game of cat and mouse.

You let your guard slip one time, and he's on you right away. Now, there's a pistol under the counter, and it's got you in its sights.

How will you escape this grim scenario? Will you surrender to the odds? Or will you try your hand at escape?

You've got one drink to get it right- One final toast to a game well played. After that, it's over for you, Bangtail~

[From [url=https://rootbandit.itch.io/last-call-at-desert-blossom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
东躲西藏的日子，你早就过惯了。你是“逃亡者”，这就是你的生活。

当然，既然各处都有人想抓你，而且个个不怀好意，紧追在你身后的赏金猎人自然也不在少数。其中最执着的，当数沃克·T·兰纳。这个长着机械脑袋的古怪杀手，似乎特别享受跟你玩猫捉老鼠。

有一回，你只不过松懈了片刻，他就立马追了上来。现在，柜台底下有一把手枪，枪口正对着你。

你要怎样走出这个死局？会认命投降，还是试着逃出生天？

你只剩喝一杯酒的时间。为这场精彩的较量最后干一杯吧。喝完，你可就完了，小短尾～
